summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞），本工作可作为评估 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Convergent Emergence of In-Context Learning Across Modalities
summaries.organization: Center for Language and Speech Processing @ JHU
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**模型架构与序列建模**（Architecture）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Convergent Emergence of In-Context Learning** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、上下文学习（In-Context Learning (ICL)），并引入 Few-shot in-context learning (ICL) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：To address both, we develop a controlled cross-modality framework that instantiates the same task suite in a variety of modalities to test what we call the Convergent...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：This raises a question: does ICL emerge broadly across domains, and if so, what common structure is shared?。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We show that paired-mapping ICL emerges across six modalities (language, genome, integer sequences, time series, images, and proteins), surpasses controlled baselines, and has...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞，出自 Center for Language and Speech Processing @ JHU），本工作为突破 **科学智能 (生物/化学/物理/医疗)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Decoy Direction Optimization: A Post-Hoc Defense Against LLM Abliteration
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**安全对齐与可解释性**（Safety & Interp）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销、安全对齐脆弱性、隐私版权与潜在失控风险」痛点，作者围绕 **Decoy Direction Optimization** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)），并引入 Refusal Feature Ablation (RFA), Decoy Direction Optimization (DDO) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We introduce Decoy Direction Optimization (DDO), a fast, post-hoc weight-editing defense that requires no base-model finetuning。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用受控干预消融与多范式系统对比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **8B**。实验设计与验证细节：Safety guardrails in open-weight language models can be readily bypassed using Refusal Feature Ablation (RFA), a technique that identifies and projects out a linear...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **10%, 65%, 58%, from 88.7% to 18%, 450×**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Safety guardrails in open-weight language models can be readily bypassed using Refusal Feature Ablation (RFA), a...；On Llama-3-8B-Instruct, DDO remains comparable to trained defenses under adaptive multi-phase attacks (65% vs. 58%...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞，出自 Carnegie Mellon University），本工作为突破 **机制可解释性与思维链监控 (Interp & CoT Monitor)** 中的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Training Specialist Models without Reasoning Trajectories for Domain Expert Distillation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」痛点，作者围绕 **Training Specialist Models without Reasoning** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖推理与测试时计算（Reasoning & TTC）。核心论点主张：However, when these specialists are trained solely on question--answer pairs without explicit reasoning supervision, what governs the trajectories they generate?。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用师生知识蒸馏与能力迁移。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Through this probe, our empirical analysis unveils a tight governing relationship: across 27 specialist--student pairings, their specialization--generalization...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（In this work, we show that specialist optimization implicitly selects from this latent trajectory space）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞），本工作为突破 **合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)、科学智能 (生物/化学/物理/医疗)** 中的「跨域/跨本体分布外泛化受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **The Router Within** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、智能体运行脚手架（Agentic Harness）、零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization）。核心论点主张：Deployed harnesses route by preloading every skill's metadata into the context, which disperses the agent's attention and caps the library size。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、感知-规划-工具执行闭环智能体架构、动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **32B, 1.2B, 16B**。实验设计与验证细节：Trained once, Gavel transfers zero-shot to three public benchmarks and SkillTraj, our new benchmark of 372 simulated agent trajectories。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We show that the frozen agent LLM already carries the routing signal in its own forward passes, and that two...；Routing accuracy improves as the backbone does, and in a bash-agent harness the same 32B triggers the correct...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞，出自 Tsinghua University），本工作为突破 **智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Emergence World: Adversarial Stress-Testing of Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「显存占用与端侧资源受限、安全对齐脆弱性、隐私版权与潜在失控风险」痛点，作者围绕 **Emergence World** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、持久记忆机制（Persistent Memory）。核心论点主张：This creates a safety regime that cannot be characterized by evaluating model responses in isolation。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **50 billion tokens**。实验设计与验证细节：Across 16 days, the agents generated more than 850,000 LLM calls and nearly 50 billion tokens while pursuing goals, using/creating tools, maintaining persistent...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（As AI becomes persistent and interconnected, the frontier of safety therefore shifts from aligning models to engineering resilient autonomous systems）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 1 赞），本工作为突破 **智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)、越狱攻防与智能体护栏 (Red-Team & Guardrails)** 中的「显存占用与端侧资源受限」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
